hooks.command: $d = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $d.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match '\.(md|html|json)$') { $n = Split-Path $f -Leaf; $who = git config user.name; git add -A; $staged = git diff --staged --name-only; if ($staged) { git commit -m "auto: update $n -- by $who"; git push origin main } } 2>$null
$who = git config user.name; git add -A; $staged = git diff --staged --name-only; if ($staged) { git commit -m "auto: session end -- by $who"; git push origin main } 2>$null
